name: globu
description: Globu: OKF knowledge bases, a per-user knowledge registry and a session status mod for Claude Code

plugins.name: globu
plugins.description: Keep OKF knowledge bases (docs/ directories) inside a repo, register knowledge shards across repos, tell Claude which knowledge exists and where it may write, and update it with what a session learned

plugins.name: globu-status
plugins.description: Status line and band showing how much the session has done since its knowledge was last updated, with one-press update
